text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere at Symboli Rudolf's<n>long-awaited
debut is as charged as<n>a real graded race, but she
only sees<n>the pressure as an opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With her back straight and head<n>unbowed, she
makes her way to the<n>track.
